title: Configure a PR team from an existing farm
description: Provide FARMSLOT_UI_URL and SETUP_FARM; set SETUP_GITHUB_LOGIN when multiple gateway accounts exist. Uses a separate browser tab and gateway config reads, with no team/rule writes or GitHub imports. Checks desktop/mobile layouts and editor polling over one minute.

setup.intent: Verify real farm metadata fills the draft, configured accounts are selected, advanced settings collapse, and editing does not request PR discovery.
